$Comment: The creatures that guard the Headless Horseman's fountain before he rises and come to his side mid-fight: the Jack Skeletons, on his hard ride the Jack Archers in its waves, and on both rides the Pumpkin Fiends his pumpkins hatch as his health falls (FightWaves), under ids of their own, Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend_Hatchling on the normal ride and Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend_Hatchling_HM on the hard one. His fight waits for every one of them in his arena to die before he rises (Macro_Orbis_Boss_Guards on the normal ride, each wave of Zc_Wave_Chain on the hard one), and clears them all when the fight resets, so the next try starts clean. The wild Pumpkin Fiend (Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend) stays out of this group, so one wandering near a fight never holds or joins it. Add a role id here, written *<id>, if he calls another kind. Each role id is written after a * the way the game's own groups write *Chicken: the star still matches that role (and only it: *Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend_Hatchling leaves the wild Hallows_Eve_Pumpkin_Fiend out), while the game works a group out again as each mod's roles load, before this pack's own, so a bare id would log a warning at every server start though the group comes out the same.
